license: GEOROC data are provided under the DIGIS/GEOROC data policy. Users must cite GEOROC and the original publications for any analysis used.
method: Per-group distributions (n, p10/p25/p50/p75/p90) of major oxides. Rocks are grouped by GEOROC's own precompiled file name; minerals by the MINERAL column. Rows filtered to whole-rock or glass material (rocks), a 97-103 wt% major-oxide total counting iron once, and at least 6 (rocks) or 4 (minerals) reported oxides.
parser: Streaming RFC 4180 reader; GEOROC files contain quoted fields with embedded newlines and a trailing bibliography block, both of which defeat line-based parsing.
